name: Hoikuen
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional nursery school (hoikuen): a hours-change notice, a first day working part-time, a belongings guide, a sports-day reschedule notice, a first-time guardian guide, a lesson in calling children by name, teaching a junior how to check naptime safely, the nursery's history of moving to a communication app, an orientation-session guide, an app-adoption trend column, a hybrid pick-up registration system guide, a reflection on balancing strict checks and warmth, and a one-year report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
